data.title: Bitdeer Announces August 2026 Production and Operations Update
data.description: Monthly Highlights AI Cloud:Bitdeer AI secured 100% contracted GPU capacity for its 9.5 MW A102 facility in Malaysia ahead of energization through long-term commitments, representing more than $800 million in total expected revenue.Bitdeer has signed a non-binding Letter of Intent to develop an AI data center in Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City, targeting an initial 30 MW of renewable hydro/solar-powered capacity with a potential expansion pathway to 500 MW.Bitdeer AI executed a 10-year data center services agreement securing an additional 65.1 MW at its A202 facility on the Johor campus, scaling total campus AI Cloud capacity to 86.8 MW to capture high-density compute demand.Colocation: Bitdeer recently acquired 200 acres near existing 563 MW Rockdale facility to support AI/HPC infrastructure development.Bitcoin: Production increased 249% Y/Y to 1,310 Bitcoins. Key Metrics Summary           AI Cloud
